$comment: Our schema of a GitHub Actions workflow, the shape GitHub reads, kept local so an editor and a gate need no download.
description: Our schema of a GitHub Actions workflow, an inner contract (ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): the shape GitHub reads, kept local so an editor and a gate need no download. source: https://json.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json (the full schema validates every job and step through patternProperties and oneOf, outside the bounded subset of ContractSchema), trimmed to the top-level shape and each job: on and jobs are required, as GitHub needs both to run a workflow, every known top-level key has its type, and every job, keyed by its own name, needs runs-on and a steps array. That is our shape, stricter than GitHub's: a job that calls a reusable workflow through uses has neither, and none of ours does. Every workflow file is bound to it by contract.yml's applies_to. Taken 2026-10-25.
